{{Quote|A large Republic fleet has entered the system. It includes the Founder, Supreme Chancellor Janarus's personal flagship.|[[Darth Tormen]]|<ref name="TOR:R">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Reckoning|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''''Founder''''' was a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] under the service of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. It served as the personal transport of the Supreme Chancellor and their entourage..<ref name="TOR" />

==Description==
Built just after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] the ''Founder'' was a modified version of a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]]. It was first seen in 3,641 BBY, and was equipped with the latest in secure communication technology, it also had a luxurious lounge and dining area and sleeping quarters for the [[Supreme Chancellor]] and their aides. The vessel included an area to conduct diplomatic discussions.
